overview: A mobile payment footer with an optional main row, optional details, a required total, an optional notice and a full-width action.

default.title: Default
default.text: The default body uses a white surface; the root itself has no background.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.text: The highlight body uses the light-up surface.

notice.title: Notice
notice.text: The description is required; the title and icon are optional.

notice-title-icon.title: Notice title and icon
notice-title-icon.text: A solid check-circle is the recommended icon. Pass null to hide it.

main-item-only.title: Main item only
main-item-only.text: The main item is independent from details and uses default density.

details-only.title: Details only
details-only.text: Details can be shown without a main item and use compact density.

four-details.title: Four details
four-details.text: Use up to four details as a screen-level rule; the component renders every supplied detail.

additional-info.title: Additional info
additional-info.text: Optional info appears below the row value and aligns to the right.

api.intro: Each row uses Transaction List Read Only, with `content` on the left and `amount` on the right. Footer renders all supplied details and leaves business behavior to the consumer.
api.type: Body appearance. `default` is white; `highlight` uses the light-up surface.
api.mainItem: Optional Transaction List Read Only item (`content` + `amount`) using Default density. It is never inferred from the first detail.
api.details: Optional Transaction List Read Only items (`content` + `amount`) using Compact density. Use at most four as a screen-level rule; the component does not truncate the list.
api.total: Required label/value row in bold. A divider precedes it whenever a main item or details are present.
api.notice: Optional structured notice. Description is required; title is optional. A solid check-circle is recommended; `icon={null}` hides it.
api.action: Required consumer-provided action, rendered full width inside the body.
api.className: Additional class name for the component root.

platforms.text: The same row data maps to `TransactionFooterRow` in SwiftUI and `OceanTransactionFooterItem` in Compose.

rules: Use Footer at the bottom of a mobile payment screen; the screen owns sticky positioning and safe-area insets.

Each row is Transaction List Read Only: `content` accepts a title and description; `amount` accepts a value, default/positive/negative/inactive/strikethrough/strikethrough-neutral type, struck-through value, tag, and info. Use mainItem and details independently; the first detail is never promoted to main.
Use no more than four details as a screen-level usage rule. Footer renders every item it receives.
The main item uses Default density and details use Compact. Rows have no internal divider; group dividers appear after main when details follow and before total whenever rows are above it.
The notice remains separate from the body, and the body overlaps it.
Use the Ocean action component for the required action.
